names.note: saint.gr prints the name in Latin letters and not in Greek — its line reads «Άγιος Birinus (Άγγλος)» and the page «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Άγγλου Αγίου Birinus» — so the form is copied exactly as the page has it, with the rank word left off. No Greek spelling is offered and none is invented here.

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page, and it prints no hymn, no distich and no year. Its whole entry is one sentence saying it has no details of the life of this English saint; it does not say whether he was a monk, an abbot or a bishop, so this folder carries no types at all. Nothing in the page identifies him further, and no identification is made here.
